turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How's the voice quality for Japanese specifically?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's improved a lot since we started six months ago, but pitch accent still sounds slightly off on certain words compared to a native speaker. Good enough for drafts, not final delivery to clients yet.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What would 'final delivery ready' look like to you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: If a native Japanese speaker on our team couldn't distinguish it from a human recording in a blind test, we'd switch entirely. We're maybe 90% there.
